readerCopy.headline: A new twelve-year chapter starts with one bigger yes.
readerCopy.body:
A plan you once thought was too large may suddenly feel possible enough to begin. You may return to an old ambition with better timing, or notice that your idea of what counts as a big life has changed. The first step may look small compared with the chapter it eventually starts.

Jupiter returning to Jupiter can make possibility feel abundant, and that is exactly why proportion matters. Pick one direction with enough substance to keep developing after the excitement wears off. You do not need to know where the next twelve years end. Give the next chapter a real beginning.
